segments.headline: Draw a pendulum
segments.narration: A line, a string, and a circle. I begin with a simple sketch, right here in the room.

segments.headline: The same lines become volume
segments.narration: Now the drawing lifts off the board. The circle opens into a wireframe sphere. It is still the same sketch.

segments.headline: Set the drawing in motion
segments.narration: A nudge brings it to life. The pendulum swings through the space beside me.

segments.headline: Draw what the motion means
segments.narration: I draw its motion as a wave. Sketching is no longer just a picture. It becomes a way to explain something that moves.
